## Setup

All inputs are read relative to this file: the Global SOC Fractions dataset and
your reference assignments from `Global_SOC_crops/`, and the DayCent model
results from `../Project_CABBI/outputs/summary/` (rerun the Project_CABBI
pipeline to refresh them). The previous version of this notebook is in
`archive/SOCMetaAnalysis_2025-11-12.Rmd`.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# DATA NOT INCLUDED: the Global Soil Carbon Fractions: Regenerative + Conventional Croplands
# dataset is not redistributed in this repository. It is available through LandEngine
# (https://landengine.org/). Citation: A. M. Prairie, A. E. King, and M. F. Cotrufo, "Restoring
# particulate and mineral-associated organic carbon through regenerative agriculture," Proc. Natl.
# Acad. Sci., vol. 120, no. 21, p. e2217481120, May 2023, doi: 10.1073/pnas.2217481120.
# Place globalsocfractions_crops.csv and the reference-assignment file
# globalsocfractions_crops_filtered_top20_referenced.csv in Global_SOC_crops/.
data_dir <- "Global_SOC_crops"
model_dir <- file.path("..", "Project_CABBI", "outputs", "summary")
shared_drive <- "G:/Shared drives/Bio+ Soil Carbon Accounting - ICCT/Technical Work"

target_depth_cm <- 20  # matches the DayCent soil pools (fix.100 EDEPTH = 0.20 m)
c_to_co2 <- 44 / 12

practice_labels <- c(NT = "No-till", RT = "Reduced-till", CC = "Cover crop")
practice_colors <- c(NT = "#2a78d6", RT = "#eb6834", CC = "#1baf7a")
```

## Global data

Global Soil Carbon Fractions: Regenerative + Conventional Croplands

- studies investigating the response of SOC pools to three soil management
  practices: tillage, cropping intensification, and integrated crop-livestock
- only points where the treatment of interest is isolated within the
  experimental design

```{r data}
dd <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "globalsocfractions_crops.csv"), header = TRUE)

# Corn systems with a reported SOC stock; keep every layer of each profile
crop_species_cols <- grep("^crop[0-9]_species$", names(dd), value = TRUE)
df <- dd %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(crop_species_cols), ~ !is.na(.) & . == "corn")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_MgC_ha)) %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, soil_depth_upper, soil_depth_lower, location, duration,
         tillage, tillage_details, crop_rotation_name, CC, avg_Nfert_rate, soil_BD,
         total_MgC_ha, total_MgC_ha_sd, reps, total_gC_kg_soil, crop_scsc, perennial,
         total_cropping_intensity)

cat("Corn layers with SOC stocks:", nrow(df), " trials:",
    nrow(distinct(df, paper_id, sid, tid)), "\n")
```

## Harmonize SOC stocks to 0-20 cm (fixed depth)

Each trial (paper_id, sid, tid) is one sampled profile. Layers wholly above
20 cm are summed; a layer that spans 20 cm contributes the share above 20 cm,
assuming uniform SOC within the layer. Only profiles that start at 0 cm and
reach at least 20 cm without gaps are kept.

```{r fixed-depth-0-20}
profiles <- df %>%
  arrange(paper_id, sid, tid, soil_depth_upper) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  mutate(thickness_cm = soil_depth_lower - soil_depth_upper,
         contiguous = soil_depth_upper == lag(soil_depth_lower, default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

profile_checks <- profiles %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(starts_at_0 = min(soil_depth_upper) == 0,
            max_depth = max(soil_depth_lower),
            contiguous_to_20 = all(contiguous[soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm]),
            duplicated_layers = any(duplicated(paste(soil_depth_upper, soil_depth_lower))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(usable = starts_at_0 & max_depth >= target_depth_cm & contiguous_to_20 &
           !duplicated_layers)

top20 <- profiles %>%
  semi_join(filter(profile_checks, usable), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  filter(soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm) %>%
  mutate(share_above_20 = pmin(1, (target_depth_cm - soil_depth_upper) / thickness_cm)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(MgC_ha_top20_fd = sum(total_MgC_ha * share_above_20), .groups = "drop")

cat("Profiles usable for 0-20 cm:", nrow(top20), "of", nrow(profile_checks), "\n")
```

## Pair treatments with their reference (your manual assignments)

`Reference` IDs come from your hand-assigned file: the reference (control)
row ends in `R`, and every treatment row with the same ID is compared to it.
Comparisons are classified by the change in tillage or cover crop as before.

```{r pairs}
ref_assign <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "globalsocfractions_crops_filtered_top20_referenced.csv"),
                       header = TRUE, check.names = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Reference), Reference != "", Reference != "X") %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, Reference, MgC_ha_top20_file = MgC_ha_top20)

trials <- profiles %>%
  distinct(paper_id, sid, tid, location, duration, tillage, CC, crop_rotation_name,
           avg_Nfert_rate) %>%
  inner_join(ref_assign, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  left_join(top20, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid"))

# The recomputed 0-20 cm stocks should match the stocks in the referenced file
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(trials$MgC_ha_top20_fd, trials$MgC_ha_top20_file)))

ref_rows <- trials %>%
  filter(grepl("R$", Reference)) %>%
  transmute(ref_id = sub("R$", "", Reference),
            ref_paper_id = paper_id, ref_sid = sid, ref_tid = tid,
            tillage_ref = tillage, CC_ref = CC, MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref = MgC_ha_top20_fd)

pairs <- trials %>%
  filter(!grepl("R$", Reference)) %>%
  mutate(ref_id = Reference) %>%
  inner_join(ref_rows, by = "ref_id") %>%
  mutate(TillChange = case_when(
           tillage == "NT" & tillage_ref == "CT" ~ "NT",
           tillage == "RT" & tillage_ref == "CT" ~ "RT",
           tillage == tillage_ref ~ "NoChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         CCChange = case_when(
           CC == "yes" & CC_ref == "no" ~ "CC",
           CC == CC_ref ~ "NoChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Change = case_when(
           TillChange == "NoChange" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "Conv",
           TillChange == "NoChange" & CCChange == "CC" ~ "CC",
           TillChange == "NT" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "NT",
           TillChange == "RT" & CCChange == "NoChange" ~ "RT",
           TillChange != "NoChange" & CCChange != "NoChange" ~ "BothCCandTillChange",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         delta_fd = MgC_ha_top20_fd - MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref,
         rate_fd = delta_fd / duration)

pairs %>% count(Change, name = "comparisons")
```

## Equivalent soil mass (studies reporting bulk density)

No-till and other practices change bulk density, so a fixed 0-20 cm depth can
contain different amounts of soil in the treatment and reference plots. For
each pair where both profiles report bulk density for every layer, the
treatment SOC is taken at the same soil mass as the reference's top 20 cm:

- soil mass per layer (Mg/ha) = bulk density (g/cm3) x thickness (cm) x 100
- reference: SOC and soil mass to 20 cm (identical to the fixed-depth value)
- treatment: cumulative SOC interpolated linearly against cumulative soil mass
  at the reference mass (uniform SOC within a layer, as in the fixed-depth
  proration); if the treatment profile holds less soil than the reference
  mass, the deepest layer's SOC per unit soil is extended (flagged)

This uses total soil mass and linear interpolation; von Haden et al. (2020)
use mineral soil mass and a monotone spline, which needs SOM data per layer.

```{r equivalent-soil-mass}
profile_mass <- profiles %>%
  semi_join(filter(profile_checks, usable), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid")) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  filter(all(!is.na(soil_BD))) %>%
  arrange(soil_depth_upper, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(soil_mass_Mg_ha = soil_BD * thickness_cm * 100,
         cum_mass = cumsum(soil_mass_Mg_ha),
         cum_soc = cumsum(total_MgC_ha)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Soil mass in a profile's top 20 cm
mass_to_20 <- profile_mass %>%
  filter(soil_depth_upper < target_depth_cm) %>%
  mutate(share_above_20 = pmin(1, (target_depth_cm - soil_depth_upper) / thickness_cm)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, sid, tid) %>%
  summarise(ref_mass_20 = sum(soil_mass_Mg_ha * share_above_20), .groups = "drop")

# SOC at a given cumulative soil mass in one profile
soc_at_mass <- function(profile, target_mass) {
  mass <- c(0, profile$cum_mass)
  soc <- c(0, profile$cum_soc)
  if (target_mass <= max(mass)) {
    return(list(soc = approx(mass, soc, xout = target_mass)$y, extrapolated = FALSE))
  }
  deepest <- profile[nrow(profile), ]
  extra <- (target_mass - max(mass)) * deepest$total_MgC_ha / deepest$soil_mass_Mg_ha
  list(soc = max(soc) + extra, extrapolated = TRUE)
}

esm <- pairs %>%
  inner_join(mass_to_20, by = c("ref_paper_id" = "paper_id", "ref_sid" = "sid",
                                "ref_tid" = "tid")) %>%
  semi_join(distinct(profile_mass, paper_id, sid, tid), by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid"))

esm_values <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(esm)), function(i) {
  treatment <- profile_mass %>%
    filter(paper_id == esm$paper_id[i], sid == esm$sid[i], tid == esm$tid[i])
  soc_at_mass(treatment, esm$ref_mass_20[i])
})
esm <- esm %>%
  mutate(MgC_ha_esm = vapply(esm_values, `[[`, numeric(1), "soc"),
         esm_extrapolated = vapply(esm_values, `[[`, logical(1), "extrapolated"),
         delta_esm = MgC_ha_esm - MgC_ha_top20_fd_ref,
         rate_esm = delta_esm / duration) %>%
  select(paper_id, sid, tid, ref_id, ref_mass_20, MgC_ha_esm, esm_extrapolated,
         delta_esm, rate_esm)

pairs <- pairs %>% left_join(esm, by = c("paper_id", "sid", "tid", "ref_id"))

cat("Pairs with an equivalent-soil-mass estimate:", sum(!is.na(pairs$rate_esm)), "of",
    nrow(pairs), "; extrapolated below the deepest layer:",
    sum(pairs$esm_extrapolated, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Average to one result per study

When a paper reports more than one comparison for the same practice change,
the comparisons are averaged so each study counts once. `delta_*` is the net
SOC difference from the conventional reference (Mg C/ha) and `rate_*` is that
difference divided by duration (Mg C/ha/yr), each averaged across comparisons.

```{r study-averages}
study <- pairs %>%
  filter(Change %in% names(practice_labels)) %>%
  group_by(paper_id, Change) %>%
  summarise(sid = paste(unique(sid), collapse = ";"),
            location = paste(unique(location), collapse = ";"),
            n_comparisons = n(),
            duration = mean(duration),
            delta_fd = mean(delta_fd),
            rate_fd = mean(rate_fd),
            n_esm = sum(!is.na(rate_esm)),
            delta_esm = if (any(!is.na(delta_esm))) mean(delta_esm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            rate_esm = if (any(!is.na(rate_esm))) mean(rate_esm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  relocate(paper_id, sid, location, duration, Change) %>%
  mutate(Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels)))

study %>% count(Change, name = "studies")
```

## DayCent model results (current Project_CABBI pipeline)

The default model run is UAN20, site-specific history, continuous management,
observed weather, and the default DEC4 (0.0025). Its net SOC is the somsc
difference from the default continuous conventional at the same N rate and
history (`cf_conv`), divided by the years since 2020, in Mg C/ha/yr; this
mirrors the empirical treatment-minus-control rate. Sensitivity points use the
30-year SOC-only, per-area credits from `accounting_results.csv` (somsc,
`cf_conv`, default DEC4), converted back to Mg C. They include the set-aside
scenarios (other N rates, cycling and adopt-then-revert patterns), which are
credited against the default conventional. The alternative conventional
definitions (`convplow`, `convrt`) are counterfactuals, not practices, and are
left out here.

```{r model}
annual <- read.csv(file.path(model_dir, "daycent_annual_summary.csv"))

model_default <- annual %>%
  filter(conservation_practice %in% c("conv", tolower(names(practice_labels))),
         n_rate == "n_obs", historic_land_use == "hlu_site", cycling_frequency == "cont",
         weather_sequence == "w_obs", dec4 == "dec4_def", year >= 2020, year <= 2050) %>%
  select(conservation_practice, year, somsc_mg_c_ha)
conv <- model_default %>% filter(conservation_practice == "conv") %>%
  select(year, conv_somsc = somsc_mg_c_ha)
model_curve <- model_default %>%
  filter(conservation_practice != "conv") %>%
  inner_join(conv, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(Change = toupper(conservation_practice),
         years = year - 2020,
         diff_mg_c_ha = somsc_mg_c_ha - conv_somsc) %>%
  group_by(Change) %>%
  mutate(diff_mg_c_ha = diff_mg_c_ha - diff_mg_c_ha[years == 0]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(years > 0) %>%
  mutate(rate_model = diff_mg_c_ha / years,
         Change = factor(Change, levels = names(practice_labels)))

stopifnot(nrow(model_curve) == 30 * length(practice_labels))
model_30 <- model_curve %>% filter(years == 30) %>% select(Change, rate_model)

# Sensitivity: other N rates, histories, cycling and reversion (30 years)
credits <- read.csv(file.path(model_dir, "accounting_results.csv"))
model_sensitivity <- credits %>%
  filter(carbon_pool == "somsc", counterfactual == "cf_conv", horizon_years == 30,
         n2o_option == "none", functional_unit == "area", weather_sequence == "w_obs",
         dec4 == "dec4_def") %>%
  mutate(Change = factor(toupper(conservation_practice), levels = names(practice_labels)),
         rate_model = soc_benefit_mg_co2e_ha_yr / c_to_co2,
         PointCategory = case_when(
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled",
           n_rate != "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled - Alt N Fert Rate",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use != "hlu_site" & cycling_frequency == "cont" ~ "Modeled - Alt HLU",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & grepl("^rev", cycling_frequency) ~ "Modeled - Cycle",
           n_rate == "n_obs" & historic_land_use == "hlu_site" & grepl("^adopt", cycling_frequency) ~ "Modeled - Revert",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PointCategory)) %>%
  select(Change, PointCategory, n_rate, historic_land_use, cycling_frequency, rate_model)

# The default sensitivity point must equal the default curve at 30 years
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  model_sensitivity %>% filter(PointCategory == "Modeled") %>% arrange(Change) %>% pull(rate_model),
  model_30 %>% arrange(Change) %>% pull(rate_model), tolerance = 1e-4)))  # credits are written rounded

```

## Match each study to the model at the same duration

The model's per-year rate changes with time, so each study is compared with
the default model rate at the study's duration. Studies longer than the
30-year model run have no matched value.

```{r matched}
study <- study %>%
  mutate(years = round(duration)) %>%
  left_join(model_curve %>% select(Change, years, rate_model_matched = rate_model),
            by = c("Change", "years"))

cat("Studies with a matched model value:", sum(!is.na(study$rate_model_matched)), "of",
    nrow(study), "\n")
```

## Compare empirical and modeled net SOC

```{r compare-boxplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
study_long <- study %>%
  pivot_longer(c(rate_fd, rate_esm), names_to = "method", values_to = "rate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(rate)) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(ifelse(method == "rate_fd", "Fixed depth (0-20 cm)",
                                "Equivalent soil mass"),
                         levels = c("Fixed depth (0-20 cm)", "Equivalent soil mass")))

study_counts <- study_long %>% count(method, Change)

sensitivity_colors <- c("Modeled - Alt N Fert Rate" = "#eda100", "Modeled - Alt HLU" = "#6250d6",
                        "Modeled - Cycle" = "#1baf7a", "Modeled - Revert" = "#e87ba4")

ggplot(study_long, aes(x = Change, y = rate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#b5b4ae") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "#52514e", width = 0.55) +
  geom_point(color = "#52514e", alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "black") +
  geom_point(data = model_sensitivity %>% filter(PointCategory != "Modeled"),
             aes(y = rate_model, color = PointCategory),
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.38), size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(data = model_30, aes(y = rate_model), color = "#e34948", size = 4,
             position = position_nudge(x = 0.38)) +
  geom_text(data = study_counts, aes(y = -Inf, label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.5,
            size = 3, color = "#52514e") +
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = practice_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "30-yr model sensitivity", values = sensitivity_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(Net~SOC~accumulation~(Mg~C~ha^-1~yr^-1)),
       caption = paste("Box/points: study-level empirical rates (black diamond = mean).",
                       "Red: default model, 30 years.",
                       "n = studies after averaging comparisons within each paper.")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r compare-duration, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.2}
reference_colors <- c("Default DayCent model" = "#d03b3b")

duration_plot <- ggplot(study_long, aes(x = duration, y = rate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#b5b4ae") +
  geom_line(data = model_curve, aes(x = years, y = rate_model, color = "Default DayCent model"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = model_curve %>% filter(years == 30),
             aes(x = years, y = rate_model, color = "Default DayCent model"), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = method), color = "#3d3c39", size = 2.2, stroke = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Change, labeller = labeller(Change = practice_labels)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.14))) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Fixed depth (0-20 cm)" = 16,
                                             "Equivalent soil mass" = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = reference_colors) +
  labs(x = "Study duration / years since adoption",
       y = expression(Annualized~net~SOC~(Mg~C~ha^-1~yr^-1)),
       caption = paste("Points: study-level empirical rates. Red: default DayCent model",
                       "(somsc vs continuous conventional, same N rate) at each year since 2020;",
                       "dot = 30 years.",
                       "Multiply by 44/12 for t CO2e/ha/yr.")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
duration_plot
ggsave("duration_vs_net_soc.png", duration_plot, width = 11, height = 5.2, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```

```{r compare-matched, fig.width=7, fig.height=6.5}
matched_long <- study_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(rate_model_matched))

axis_limits <- range(c(matched_long$rate, matched_long$rate_model_matched))

ggplot(matched_long, aes(x = rate, y = rate_model_matched, color = Change)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "#b5b4ae") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = method), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = practice_colors, labels = practice_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Fixed depth (0-20 cm)" = 16,
                                             "Equivalent soil mass" = 1)) +
  coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
  labs(x = "Empirical net SOC (Mg C/ha/yr)", y = "Default model at the same duration (Mg C/ha/yr)",
       caption = "Grey line: 1:1. Points above it: model higher than the study; below: model lower.") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summary table

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- study_long %>%
  group_by(method, Change) %>%
  summarise(studies = n(),
            mean = mean(rate), median = median(rate),
            q25 = quantile(rate, 0.25), q75 = quantile(rate, 0.75),
            mean_duration = mean(duration), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(model_30 %>% rename(model_30yr = rate_model), by = "Change") %>%
  left_join(matched_long %>% group_by(method, Change) %>%
              summarise(model_matched_mean = mean(rate_model_matched),
                        empirical_matched_mean = mean(rate), matched_studies = n(),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("method", "Change")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean, median, q25, q75, model_30yr, model_matched_mean,
                  empirical_matched_mean), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         mean_t_co2e = round(mean * c_to_co2, 3),
         model_30yr_t_co2e = round(model_30yr * c_to_co2, 3))

knitr::kable(summary_table,
             caption = "Net SOC accumulation, Mg C/ha/yr (t CO2e/ha/yr = Mg C x 44/12)")
```

```{r save-outputs}
write.csv(pairs, "empirical_soc_pairs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(study, "empirical_soc_study_means.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(summary_table, "empirical_vs_model_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Notes

- Comparisons are used as assigned in the reference file, including pairs whose
  rotation differs from the reference beyond the practice change.
- Durations are years since the practice began; dividing the paired difference
  by duration assumes treatment and reference started from the same SOC.
- The empirical studies are global, while the model is one Illinois site.
- The archived notebook (`archive/SOCMetaAnalysis_2025-11-12.Rmd`) keeps the
  earlier exploratory sections (GRACEnet, literature values, the von Haden ESM
  example, and the original plots).
